milestone.describes: The run starts: the pig is moving with the monkey on its back, the tutorial prompt is up, and both control buttons are live.

steps.expect: Menu: Play across the middle, the monkey and pig below it, and four round buttons along the bottom.
Gameplay. The pig runs, "Tap [monkey] To grab the [banana]" is shown, and the monkey and pig buttons sit in the bottom corners.

notes: This app used to carry --landscape-native. That was a workaround for a presentation bug, not a fact about the app; with the bug fixed it needs the ordinary rotation. If a replay shows the frame in a narrow portrait strip on the left with black beside it, check the launch options before anything else.

The button-to-touch mappings in tapHLE_default_options.txt are for controller play and are not needed to replay this route: A is the monkey button at (43, 274), B the pig button at (439, 274), Start pause at (22, 22).

Tilt steers the pig, so a replay cannot drive the run any further than its first seconds without accelerometer input. Reaching gameplay with the tutorial prompt live is the milestone this map records.
